notes.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false; UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29): every event on this screen is a cut to its end, so the host sends hold 0 and runs what follows an event's end (a hand-off, a jump, the next state) on the frame of the key; nothing waits on a still frame. The roll's dither is a cut; Grow it prints the stamp, sets the code and lands on the Incubator, growing, on the frame of ✓. A press that ends an event with `cut: true` also acts (habitat.json notes.cut); no event here cuts.

roll.do: the founder's old picture cross-dithers to the new over the founder's box (16 Bayer levels, 200 ms; a pixel the two pictures share shows the same at every level, so only the changed pixels cross) when both the silhouette box (pixels clear, alpha 0, in one picture and not the other) and the change box (pixels whose alpha differs, or whose RGB differs where neither is clear) fit in gate.silhouette and gate.change; otherwise a cut on the frame of the key: a re-posed body, or a colour over the whole body, never dithers (fix 5 Create C8; CD 07:10). The face computes both boxes from the two pictures it holds (architect fix 5 Q5). The roll, the ring, the line, the pip, the stamp and the price change at once (cuts); on the bench a turn is one cut on the drum, then this dither on the founder; the drum, the slip and the price change at once (cuts)
